name: Agilis Flannel Rodoria
original_name: アギリス・フランネル＝ロードリア
source: Hell king of Rodoria, a pure fire dragon and father of Shanan. While respecting the previous demon lord of Gurizani and their non-aggression treaty, he is conquering the rest of the demon world and mercilessly killing anyone who oppose him with his incredible power. An absolute ruler.
translation: Hell king of Rodoria, a pure fire dragon and father of Shanan. While respecting the previous demon lord of Gurizani and their non-aggression treaty, he is conquering the rest of the demon world and mercilessly killing anyone who oppose him with his incredible power. An absolute ruler.
